title: Go Fast Case Resolution Card with Appendix
doc_notes: This document is an AARO case resolution report for the 'Go Fast' UAP incident, detailing the methodology used to analyze the FLIR video and concluding that the object's behavior was not anomalous.

incidents.summary: A U.S. Navy F/A-18F pilot recorded an object using a FLIR sensor off the coast of Florida, which appeared to move at high speed but was later assessed to be moving at wind-consistent speeds due to motion parallax.
incidents.explanation: The object's apparent high speed is attributed to motion parallax; it was likely a small drone or bird moving with the wind.
incidents.quote: AARO assesses with high confidence that the object did not move at anomalous speeds.
